api_key.description: The API key to use for authenticating with Metabase. Can also be set with the METABASE_API_KEY environment variable.

headers.description: Optional headers to attach to every request to Metabase.

host.description: The Host URL of the Metabase instance to manage. Can also be set with the METABASE_HOST environment variable.

password.description: The password of the super user to use when interacting with Metabase. Can also be set with the METABASE_PASSWORD environment variable.

username.description: The username of the super user to use when interacting with Metabase. Can also be set with the METABASE_USERNAME environment variable.

details.description: Serialised JSON string containing the configuration options for the database engine. Use `details_secure` for any sensitive configuration details (eg, password).

details_secure.description: Serialised JSON string containing any sensitive configuration options for the database engine.

engine.description: The engine type of the database.

features.description: The features this database engine supports.

schedules.description: The schedules used to sync the database.

block.description: Allows you to manage a database configuration

id.description: The ID of the permissions group.

name.description: The name of the permissions group.

block.description: Allows for creating and managing permissions groups (user groups) in Metabase.

common_name.description: The user's common name, which is a combination of their first and last names.

date_joined.description: The timestamp of when the user was created.

email.description: The email address of the user.

first_login.description: The timestamp of when the user first logged into Metabase.

first_name.description: The first name of the user.

google_auth.description: Whether the user was created via Google SSO. Note, if this is enabled then username/password log-in will not be possible.

group_ids.description: The IDs of the user groups the user is a member of. The 'All Users' group is automatically added by Metabase and you can use `is_superuser` to add the user to the 'Administrators' group.

is_active.description: Used to indicate whether a user is active or if they've been deleted.

is_qbnewb.description: If false then the user has been introduced to how the Query Builder works.

is_superuser.description: Whether the user is a member of the built-in Admin group.

last_login.description: The timestamp of the user's most recent login to Metabase.

last_name.description: The last name of the user.

ldap_auth.description: Whether the user was created via LDAP. Note, if this is enabled then username/password log-in will not be possible.

locale.description: The locale the user has configured for themselves. The site default is used if this is nil.

updated_at.description: The timestamp of when the user was last updated.
